Found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes:

1. **#PD-4492**: Eau Claire gatehouse kiosk alerts (drivers at Dock Doors 14–18 not getting SMS bay assignments). Thea Ramaswell submitted it on 4 Oct 2025. Source: `teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md` ("Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth", 5 Oct 2025).
2. **#4419**: Gatehouse barcode scanners failing to read trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift, logged by Thea. It was escalated to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing. Source: `teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md` ("Moss: North cheat sheet", undated).

The other North digests (9/14 pipeline, 3/23 renewals) mention Quarrendon but give no ticket number. I left out the Central digests' #4409 and #4412, since they belong to Pree's account, not Quarrendon.

I only checked Moss's notes, so Marcus's own notes aren't included. One of them also cites #4419, but for a different issue (Gate 3 printer lag), so you may want to check that number before it goes in the weekly notes.
